afterImage.description: Skyservice US is Instar's U.S. fixed-base-operation and aircraft-services platform, formerly known as Leading Edge Jet Center. The business provides aircraft fueling, hangar, maintenance, aircraft-on-ground support and related business-aviation services from airport facilities in the United States. Leading Edge Jet Center was founded in 2005 and established as a standalone company in August 2019; Instar's current portfolio materials date the U.S. relationship to 2019 and continue to distinguish Skyservice US from the separately sponsored Canadian Skyservice investment. The U.S. platform acquired Kenmore Aero Services' FBO business in September 2020 and Exec Air Montana, including Montana Medical Transport, in December 2020 before four Leading Edge locations adopted the Skyservice brand in November 2021. Instar remains the disclosed sponsor, while the exact U.S. stake, acquisition vehicle and any co-investor allocation have not been publicly disclosed. No later sponsor exit or signed ownership transfer was identified through September 3, 2026.
